entities.summary: Paulo Schroeber (b. 1973-08-18, Caxias do Sul) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Caxias do Sul and Brazil. Known in the fields of brazil, composers & musicians, americas.
